summary: Locafy Ltd, a Nasdaq-listed Australian SaaS firm, agreed on October 1, 2026, to acquire the assets and customer base of U.S.-based Map Labs for up to US$3.0 million cash, disclosed via Form 6-K on October 6, 2026. Terms comprise US$2.0 million upfront plus US$1.0 million contingent on 2027 and 2028 revenue hurdles of US$3.84 million and US$4.76 million. No securities are issued; the upfront portion is to be funded primarily through a debt facility. Closing is targeted on or before December 31, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Watch regulatory clearance and financing execution.
